## Checklist

- [ ] The PR closes an approved issue.
- [ ] The source and base follow the documented GitFlow route.
- [ ] Exactly one `type:*` label is present.
- [ ] Focused tests and relevant harnesses pass.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] Package contents were inspected if packaging changed.
- [ ] Documentation matches the behavior.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and contain no attribution trailers.
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, private screenshots, or crash artifacts are included.
